children: The end-to-end process of designing, building, and deploying systems that automate workflows, make decisions, and handle repetitive tasks. Includes RPA, ML-powered decision pipelines, and exception management.
How is AI automation different from simple rule-based automation?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-394e8ed e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Traditional automation follows fixed rules. AI automation can learn from data, adapt to exceptions, and optimize workflows without manual intervention.
How much do AI automation services cost?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-ffc8a6b e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: A focused automation proof-of-concept starts from $15K. Full production systems with workflow integration, ML models, and monitoring typically range from $50K to $200K, defined precisely in Discovery.
How long does it take to build an AI automation system?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-b4393d0 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Proof-of-concept: 6–10 weeks. Full production deployment: 3–6 months, depending on process complexity, data readiness, and integration needs.
What data or inputs are needed to start an AI automation project?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-0919519 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: It depends on the workflow. Structured data, operational rules, documents, or API access may be required. All requirements are assessed in the Discovery Sprint.
Can AI automation systems integrate with existing software?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-ce6c8f7 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Yes. AI automation integrates with your CRM, ERP, helpdesk, databases, and internal platforms. Integration architecture is scoped in Discovery.
Can AI automation handle multiple workflows or departments?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-bd8b4ee e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Yes. We design scalable automation pipelines capable of managing multiple processes simultaneously with consistent accuracy and reliability.
How do you hire AI automation developers for a project?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-07ccb7d e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Start with a Discovery Sprint to define scope, architecture, and team requirements. We then assign the right mix of AI engineers, ML specialists, and RPA developers to your project.
